evidence_level_on_completion: VALIDATION (Q0b, Q1-Q3 descriptive; H1-H3 pre-registered directional tests)

model.source: Hugging Face only; Kaggle's own Gemma copy is never substituted

sae.excluded_reason: fp32 weights (19.34 GB) exceed one 16 GB T4; splitting, bf16 weights or CPU offload would change the M6 protocol

sampling.order: read from M6's committed sample_manifest.csv; never regenerated
sampling.holdout_reserve: the next 512 eligible documents of the same permutation; never read by R3

tokenization.policy: truncate: first window only, one window per document, no packing

positions.bos: never reconstructed, never spliced, excluded from all metrics

per_sae: original (recomputed, must equal the layer's first pass bit for bit)

seeds.random_error_reseed: re-seeded at the start of each SAE's pass over the documents, documents in rank order

fp32_reference.device_map: embedding, output head and layers 0-12 on GPU 0; layers 13-25 and final norm on GPU 1

Q0b.within_margin_if: 95% CI upper bound of mean |bf16 - fp32| < margin
Q0b.beyond_margin_if: 95% CI lower bound of mean |bf16 - fp32| > margin

H1.d: dCE_SAE(lower L0) - dCE_SAE(higher L0), adjacent pairs

H2.anchor: each 16k SAE; target = its measured Pile L0
H2.members: same layer, other widths, |measured L0 - target| <= 0.10 * target
H2.d: dCE_SAE(narrower) - dCE_SAE(wider), adjacent pairs by width

H3.d: doc-mean dCE_SAE - doc-mean dCE_random, per SAE
H3.p: one-sided, normal approximation z = mean d / bootstrap SE

validity_gates.V0: two GPUs named Tesla T4, compute capability 7.5; bf16_native recorded; internet on; pinned config.json downloads with the Kaggle secret
validity_gates.V1: as M6: data sha256, manifest sha256 = sample_info.json, 512 + 64 disjoint, text and token hashes match
validity_gates.V3_original_logits: per-SAE recomputed original logits equal the layer's first pass bit for bit
validity_gates.V4: measured L0 within factor 2 of release average_l0 and EV > 0; a failing SAE is excluded and reported
validity_gates.V5: exactly the pinned IDs at the pinned revision; params.npz sha256 recorded
validity_gates.V6: ladder vs M6 committed rows on the canonical 16k SAEs: EXACTLY / WITHIN MARGIN / FAILED
validity_gates.V7: per-SAE GPU placement and peak memory per GPU recorded; OOM -> not evaluated
validity_gates.V8: fp32 run: float32 parameters and logits, TF32 off, V2 and V3 pass
validity_gates.V9: resumed run recomputes the first finished SAE (pre-registered order) on the first 32 eval documents and reused mean-ablation vectors; pass within relative difference 1e-6; bit-identity recorded separately
validity_gates.V10: no exact token and no hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,} in any output file or log before outputs leave Kaggle

plan.K0: V0, smoke (8 eval + 4 reference docs), fp32 reference

runs.tier_b_rule: only after all Tier A runs pass their gates; whole width or nothing; must finish before the 2026-11-22 technical freeze

amendments.change: Hardware AWS A10G -> Kaggle T4 x2; Q0 and Part A1 dropped; Q0b = T4 bf16 vs fp32; T4 memory placement; Kaggle run plan K0-K6; per-SAE outputs with resume and gate V9; HF_TOKEN from Kaggle Secrets and gate V10.
amendments.reason: The AWS free plan has no GPU instances.

clarifications.text: V6 active-latent agreement compares the 128-token-chunked SAE with the unchunked SAE on the same activations (M6 did not save active-latent sets).
